description: Adds the governed-SDD host-impact declaration to new task records and routes host-sensitive work to preserve evidence-qualified claims.
delta: Task blueprint v12 adds mutually exclusive NOT_APPLICABLE and REQUIRED host-impact declaration shapes. Implementation routing v1 explains classification and blocks a host-sensitive task that cannot obtain its required evidence, without adding lifecycle parsing or host enforcement.
verification: a clean governed-SDD upgrade from 1.1.39 installs both host-impact declaration shapes and host-impact routing while preserving consumer-owned text outside protected regions
